## Answers

**h01** — `s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:16`, refreshes expiring S3 presigned URLs on attachments) — every 12 h (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, runner.go:27; ticker loop `Run` runner.go:29-41), plus one immediate pass at boot — wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners`: `s3presign.NewRunner(s.Store)` + `RunOnce(ctx)` at **server/server.go:162-163**, goroutine `Run(s3Context)` at server/server.go:167-171 (called from `Server.Start`, server/server.go:129).

**h02** — Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`, actual wire call `safeClient.Do(req)` at internal/webhook/webhook.go:152 (async path: `PostAsync` → queue → 4 worker goroutines call `Post`, webhook.go:184, 39, 42-55). Protection: SSRF guard at dial time — `safeDialContext` resolves the host and rejects reserved/private IPs (internal/webhook/webhook.go:59-77) using `isReservedIP`/`reservedCIDRs` (internal/webhook/validate.go:14-54); plus config-time validation `webhook.ValidateURL` (internal/webhook/validate.go:62-83, called from `CreateUserWebhook`/`UpdateUserWebhook`, server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go:53,106). Bypass switch: `webhook.AllowPrivateIPs` (validate.go:41), set from `--allow-private-webhooks` at cmd/memos/main.go:49,133.

**h03** — Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go:3`, `IdentityProviderUserInfo` contract). Implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (`oauth2.IdentityProvider`, `ExchangeToken`/`UserInfo`, internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:20,47,83) — OAuth2/OIDC only; it is the sole provider type constructed (`storepb.IdentityProvider_OAUTH2` branch, server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:120-121).

**h04** — **No.** `mysql.NewDB` (store/db/mysql/mysql.go:20) has exactly one caller, `db.NewDBDriver` at **store/db/db.go:22** (map: `[ArchMap query]` returns that single row); a text scan for `mysql.` across the Go tree shows no other construction — remaining hits are the upstream `go-sql-driver` API inside the package itself (store/db/mysql/mysql.go:17,30,73) and the testcontainers MySQL module in test code (store/test/containers.go:101-105).

**h05** — Mechanism: **explicit Go code**, per driver, inside the delete-user transaction. Two statements: `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (reactions on the user's memo tree) and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (reactions authored by the user) — store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:380-403 (called from `deleteUserTargetsTx`, sqlite/user_delete.go:96,102), mirrored at store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:420,438 and store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:383,401. Not a DB rule: the `reaction` table has no foreign key at all (store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-99, mysql/LATEST.sql:91-98, postgres/LATEST.sql:91-98 — only `memo_share` carries `ON DELETE CASCADE`), and SQLite is opened with `_pragma=foreign_keys(0)` (store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53) so FKs wouldn't fire anyway.

**h06** — Handlers (all reach a user-configured webhook URL): `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70), `APIV1Service.UpdateMemo` (memo_service.go:401), `APIV1Service.DeleteMemo` (memo_service.go:518), `APIV1Service.CreateMemoComment` (memo_service_comments.go:20), plus `SetMemoAttachments` (memo_attachment_service.go:16) and `SetMemoRelations` (memo_relation_service.go:16) via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (memo_update_helpers.go:66). Path: handler → `DispatchMemoCreated/Updated/Deleted/CommentCreatedWebhook` (memo_service_webhooks.go:15-30) → `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (memo_service_webhooks.go:48) → `webhook.PostAsync`. Convergence function: **`webhook.Post` — internal/webhook/webhook.go:120** (single point where the HTTP request is issued, line 152).

**h07**
- `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` (route `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar`) — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168 (registered at fileserver.go:124)
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715
- `Store.GetUser` (checks `userCache`, else delegates) — store/user.go:148
- `Store.ListUsers` → `s.driver.ListUsers` — store/user.go:136-137
- `sqlite.DB.ListUsers` (default driver; SQL against `user`) — store/db/sqlite/user.go:88 (mysql/user.go:84, postgres/user.go:87 for the other drivers)
- Image bytes come from the user row itself: `parseDataURI(user.AvatarURL)` decodes the stored base64 data URI — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:196, 737

**h08**
- `s3presign.Runner.RunOnce` — server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43 — **invoked** — `Server.startBackgroundRunners` (server/server.go:163) and `s3presign.Runner.Run` (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36)
- `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27 — **not invoked** — certified-zero callers from the map; the only production use of that package is the package-level `RebuildMemoPayload` (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447), so the `Runner` type is unreferenced

**h09** — Count: **8** declarations — `v1.SSEHub.Close` (server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99), `cache.Cache.Close` (store/cache/cache.go:187), `cache.Interface.Close` (store/cache/cache.go:31), `mysql.DB.Close` (store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47), `postgres.DB.Close` (store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46), `sqlite.DB.Close` (store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67), `store.Driver.Close` (store/driver.go:12), `store.Store.Close` (store/store.go:72).
Invoked from non-test server code:
- `store.Store.Close` ← `Server.Shutdown`, server/server.go:146
- `cache.Cache.Close` (×3 caches) ← `Store.Close`, store/store.go:74-76
- `store.Driver.Close` ← `Store.Close`, store/store.go:78 — which dispatches at runtime to `sqlite.DB.Close` (default driver) / `mysql.DB.Close` / `postgres.DB.Close`
- `v1.SSEHub.Close` ← `Server.closeLongLivedConnections`, server/server.go:206
(`cache.Interface.Close` is the interface declaration; no non-test caller goes through it.)

**h10** — `filter.renderer.addArg` — internal/filter/render.go:842 — ~28 inbound call edges from 14 distinct caller methods (`renderScalarComparison`, `renderTagInList`, `foldedLike`, `renderRegex`, `buildJSONArrayLike`, etc., internal/filter/render.go:200-851). Runner-up under `internal/`: `filter.Schema.Field` (internal/filter/schema.go:67, ~19).

**h11** — 1st: **`store.User`** (store/user.go:29) — ~85 inbound refs spread over ~6 packages outside `store*`: `server/router/api/v1` (37), `server/auth` (6), `server/notification` (5), `server/router/fileserver` (2), `server/router/rss` (1), `server/router/api/v1/test` (2). 2nd: **`store.Memo`** (store/memo.go:35) — ~57 inbound, 4 outside packages: `server/router/api/v1` (22), `server/notification` (7), `server/router/rss` (1), `server/runner/memopayload` (1). (`store.Attachment`, store/attachment.go:16, is close on raw count but touches only 2 outside packages.)

**h12** — Concrete method: **`sqlite.DB.CreateMemo` — store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16** (the `INSERT INTO \`memo\` …` at store/db/sqlite/memo.go:41). Determination: `Store.CreateMemo` only delegates to the `Driver` interface (store/memo.go:109-113); the interface is bound once in the factory `db.NewDBDriver`, which switches on `profile.Driver` (store/db/db.go:18-24); the default for that flag/viper key is `"sqlite"` (cmd/memos/main.go:122 and :130), and with no `--dsn` the sqlite path also synthesizes the DSN (internal/profile/profile.go:110). So the `sqlite` case is the branch taken; mysql/postgres `CreateMemo` are unreachable without explicit flags.

**h13** — Impl: the unexported struct `markdown.service` (internal/markdown/markdown.go:58) — the only implementation of `markdown.Service` (interface at internal/markdown/markdown.go:31). Construction: `markdown.NewService(WithTagExtension(), WithMentionExtension())` inside `v1.NewAPIV1Service` (server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51); test-only second site `test.NewTestService` (server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:24). Holders of the interface: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35), `rss.RSSService.MarkdownService` (server/router/rss/rss.go:45, injected from the API service at server/server.go:85), `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16).

**h14** — Computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88), which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll` (internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-422) and writes `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`. Triggers: `CreateMemo` (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108) and `UpdateMemo` when content changes (memo_service.go:446-450); bulk backfill in `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:52) — that runner has no production caller (see h08). Extracted: `#tags` (deduped), `@mentions`, and `Property{Title` (leading H1 text), `HasLink`, `HasCode`, `HasTaskList`, `HasIncompleteTasks}` — internal/markdown/markdown.go:376-405. A related derived field, `Memo.Snippet`, is computed per-response, not stored: `getMemoContentSnippet` → `GenerateSnippet(…, 64)` (server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-85, applied at memo_service_converter.go:76-80).

**h15** — Distinct enforcement sites:
- `APIV1Service.checkMemoAccess` (single-memo read gate) — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:44-66
- `ListMemos` visibility narrowing — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-226
- `ListAllUserStats`/user stats narrowing — server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:83-91
- Comments: create gate + list filter — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41 and :157-160
- Relations list filter — server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:108-111
- Memo→proto converter relation/comment filter — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:183-186
- Reactions: upsert/delete gates — server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:38 and :83
- Attachment access gate — server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:445-452; memo-attachment list gate — server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:222
- HTTP file server attachment permission — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:677 and :699
- RSS feeds: PUBLIC-only queries — server/router/rss/rss.go:90 and :141
- Mention-notification eligibility — server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:62-67
- Notification/inbox visibility — server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:309-315; email notifications — server/notification/email.go:313-319

**r01** — Premise wrong: there is no Redis anywhere in the backend (no `redis` import or identifier in 343 Go files; no Redis client in go.mod). The cache layer is a process-local in-memory cache: `store/cache/cache.go` (`Cache` with `sync.Map`, TTL per item, background `cleanupLoop`, cache.go:66-215). Three caches are created in `store.New` — `instanceSettingCache`, `userCache`, `userSettingCache` — all with the same hard-coded config: **DefaultTTL 10 minutes**, CleanupInterval 5 minutes, MaxItems 1000 (store/store.go:40-53). So user entries expire 10 minutes after `Set` (`Store.GetUser`/`ListUsers`/`UpdateUser` refresh them: store/user.go:122,132,143,167).

**r02** — Premise wrong: there is no rate-limiting middleware, per-user or otherwise, and no limits to report. A text scan for `RateLimit|rate_limit|Limiter|Throttle|golang.org/x/time/rate` over the Go tree returns nothing but unrelated hits, and the registered middleware chain is exactly `middleware.Recover()` + CORS (server/server.go:51-52), static file middleware (server/router/frontend/frontend.go:54), and the auth/logging/recovery/metadata interceptors for gateway and Connect (server/router/api/v1/v1.go:69-97, 133-138). The only throttles are concurrency semaphores, not request-rate limits: `thumbnailSemaphore`=3 / `imageProcessingSemaphore`=2 (server/router/api/v1/v1.go:59-60), fileserver `maxConcurrentThumbnails` (server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:116), and a request body cap of 256 MiB (v1.go:20,126).

**r03** — Premise wrong: no cron scheduler is running, so no nightly cleanup job and no time. A generic cron library exists at `internal/scheduler` (`Scheduler`, `ParseCronExpression`, `Register`, `Start` — internal/scheduler/scheduler.go:12-169), but it is imported only by its own tests (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go:10`, `internal/scheduler/integration_test.go:13`), and `scheduler.New`/`Scheduler.Register` have certified-zero callers in the graph. The only background schedule in the server is the 12-hour ticker of the S3 presign runner (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-41, wired at server/server.go:162-171).

**r04** — Premise wrong: neither — there is no message broker and no queue declaration (no NATS/RabbitMQ/AMQP identifier in the Go tree; nothing in go.mod). Webhook delivery is in-process: a package-level buffered Go channel `asyncPostQueue = make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)` (internal/webhook/webhook.go:39) drained by 4 goroutines started in `init()` (internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55), each calling `Post` (webhook.go:120). Enqueue is non-blocking and drops on overflow with a warning (`PostAsync`, webhook.go:184-196) — so deliveries are best-effort and lost on process restart.

**r05** — Premise wrong: there is no GraphQL schema or server. The public API is Protobuf/gRPC-defined (`proto/api/v1/*.proto` — ai, attachment, auth, common, idp, instance, memo, shortcut, user services) exposed three ways: gRPC-Gateway REST under `/api/v1/*` (74 generated routes, e.g. `POST /api/v1/memos`, `GET /api/v1/{name=memos/*}`, proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go:1745; registered at server/router/api/v1/v1.go:99-128), Connect-RPC under `/memos.api.v1.*` (v1.go:139-144), and SSE at `GET /api/v1/sse` (server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go:25). Non-gRPC surfaces: file server `/file/attachments/:uid/:filename` and `/file/users/:identifier/avatar` (server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:123-124), RSS `/explore/rss.xml` and `/u/:username/rss.xml` (server/router/rss/rss.go:72,111), MCP `/mcp` (server/router/mcp/service.go:109), `/healthz` (server/server.go:67), `robots.txt`/`sitemap.xml` (server/router/frontend/frontend.go:128,143).
